summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (mid-April to mid-October) already manual. Added 50-amp electric at the 7 electric sites, 25 sites (non-electric 15-30 ft, electric to 73 ft, one pull-through), showers/flush toilets/dump, no camp store or laundry on site. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded (statewide table).
